nodeAnswers.thm-1-1: Theorem 1.1 (`thm101`), p. 2 — **verified**. The local-image claim is inherited from Theorem 3.5 (`thm401`, p. 11), whose local input is Proposition 4.4 (`prop4`, p. 23): after Proposition 4.2 constructs the local descent as a meromorphic operator family, one fixes \(s_0\) with \(\operatorname{Re}(s_0)\ge 0\) and additionally assumes that this family is holomorphic there; Proposition 4.4 then uses an open-Bruhat-cell test-section construction to show that no nonzero smooth contragredient functional annihilates its image. At a non-Archimedean place, admissibility and finite length imply that a proper image would possess such an annihilator, so the map is **surjective**. At an Archimedean place, Hahn–Banach and smoothing show only that a nondense image would possess such an annihilator, so the proved conclusion is **dense image in the smooth Fréchet topology**, not surjectivity. The paper does not determine every regular \(s_0\); holomorphy of the operator family at the chosen point remains an explicit hypothesis.
